flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds show a slight drop in the Democrats' chances of winning control of the Senate, though they remain the favoured party. In [[Maine]], a predicted flip, the Democrat Troy Jackson saw a sizable drop in their chances. In [[Kansas]], also a predicted flip, the Democrat Adam Hamilton gained ground by a moderate amount.
summaries.governor: The biggest move came in [[Kansas]], where the Republican Ty Masterson saw a sizable drop in chances in what the market treats as a predicted flip. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford gained ground by a sizable amount, also a predicted flip. The Polymarket odds also show the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms making a moderate gain in [[Georgia]].
summaries.house: The Democrats' chances of winning House control slipped slightly in the Polymarket odds today. In [[NJ-02 (Vineland & Atlantic City)]], the Republican Jeff Van Drew saw a sharp drop in chances against the Democrat Zack Mullock, while in [[VA-01 (Williamsburg & Poquoson)]] the Democrat Shannon Taylor gained sharply on the Republican Rob Wittman, a predicted flip. The projected seat count also shifted to 240-195, down from 241-194, which still means Democrats gain control.
